source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Use Ireasoning MIB browser professional:
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Open Ireasoning MIB browser, load the MIB files.
4. Setup the settings of MIB browser to access BMC according to the WEB UI SNMPv3 settings.
5. Left-click on the $target and expand subtree.
6. Right-Click on the node and use "Get Next" or "Get Subtree" to get all the values of the $target.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
Use NetSNMP to check.
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Put the mib files into the netsnmp search path.
http://www.net-snmp.org/docs/FAQ.html#Where_should_I_put_my_MIB_files_
4. Use NetSNMP "get type" of command(s) to retrieve the values of the $target from BMC.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: snmpwalk (net-snmp), BMC SNMP agent must be enabled + community configured
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- SNMP "monitor_powerModule" monitoring reads specific BMC MIB data via the SNMP agent; from a 2nd management host run `snmpwalk -v2c -c ${SNMP_COMMUNITY:?operator must set SNMP community (v2c) or v3 creds} "$BMC_IP" .1.3.6.1.4.1.8072.2.3.2.1.2 | grep -i power (or walk the vendor MIB subtree once the SNMP community/v3 creds + MIB are configured). Enable + point SNMP agent first.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL snmpwalk output for the power-module OID subtree so the user confirms the monitor_powerModule SNMP data is correct.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: SNMP queries need a management host + enabled/configured SNMP agent on the BMC (community/v3 + firewall); enabling SNMP is a config change, and some BMC SNMP sets expose credentials - use read-only community.

original_test_intent: Retrieve the platform-defined power-module inventory and telemetry over SNMPv3 and verify each PSU/module's slot identity, presence, health, redundancy role and approved electrical values against the Project power topology and operating-state limits without exercising power controls.
original_method: An engineer enables an SNMPv3 account in WebUI and uses IReasoning MIB Browser Get Next/Get Subtree on undefined `$target`; Criteria switch to Net-SNMP without defining modules, fields or acceptance.
manual_activity: An engineer must configure SNMPv3, approve PSU slot/redundancy and electrical-field mappings, and establish the intended AC-input, host-load and power-policy state. The agent can then perform bounded typed reads and comparisons.
required_inputs: vendor MIB module/version and exact PSU/power-module OIDs
index-to-slot/FRU/model identity and expected populated-module topology
presence, health, fault and redundancy-role enum meanings
voltage/current/power/energy types, units, scale/exponent, precision, limits and tolerance
AC input, host load, power-cap/redundancy policy and stabilization state
least-privilege SNMPv3 profile/ACL and independent Redfish/PMBus/WebUI reference
approved client equivalence and cleanup policy
safety_requirements: Keep execution read-only: never issue SNMP SET, PSU enable/disable, power cap, redundancy-policy, failover, host power or threshold changes.
Do not infer redundancy from module count alone; correlate input presence, module health, role and platform policy.
Do not use v2c, the generic `.1.3.6.1.4.1.8072...` example or grep-only/empty output as power-module evidence.
Bind every numeric value to a module, unit and documented conversion before comparing it with limits.
Stop and escalate on redundancy loss, PSU fault, unsafe/implausible electrical value or BMC instability; do not induce failover, continue load blindly or retry automatically.
Protect secrets and unnecessary FRU serials, restore temporary SNMPv3 configuration and verify power/redundancy state remained unchanged.
agent_execution_scope: After engineer setup, query exact vendor-MIB module inventory, state and approved electrical objects via bounded SNMPv3 GET/GETNEXT/WALK.
Map every typed response to its slot/module and declared operating state, decode only documented scaling and correlate with independent Redfish/PMBus/WebUI telemetry.
Do not operate WebUI, control power/redundancy/thresholds, induce faults, claim IReasoning coverage when only Net-SNMP ran or issue a DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the module/slot/FRU/object/enum and electrical-unit/limit matrix plus expected redundancy topology.
Establish and supervise the safe AC/load/policy state, configure/restore SNMPv3 and approve tool equivalence.
Own response to power faults or redundancy loss and issue PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The wrong security mode and unrelated demonstration OID cannot bind data to a PSU slot or establish health, redundancy, units, scaling or limits; grep discards typed context.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use exact approved vendor power-module SNMPv3 objects with complete typed/indexed output, documented conversion and slot/redundancy correlation; exclude all write/control objects.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IReasoning, SNMPv3 WebUI/account setup, undefined `$target`, Net-SNMP Criteria and 10/5-minute values remain preserved source evidence.

modernized_recommendation.status: PROJECT POWER-MODULE TOPOLOGY AND TELEMETRY CONTRACT REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map each MIB index to a physical PSU/module slot and FRU, collect presence/health/redundancy plus approved electrical fields in a declared input/load/policy state, and compare with Project limits and independent BMC/PMBus evidence without any control action.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The identified chassis, PSU population/model/firmware, BMC firmware and matching vendor MIB.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis, PSU model/firmware, BMC/MIB/client and redundancy-policy versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor power-module MIB, PSU/PMBus telemetry specification, platform power topology and Project limits.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds module identity, redundancy topology, operating state, typed electrical conversion and strict no-control boundaries without replacing the original client checkpoint.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Module presence does not prove healthy redundancy, and correct voltage alone does not prove every electrical field or PSU role; Net-SNMP also cannot claim IReasoning GUI coverage unless approved.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Modules/objects/enums, units/scales/limits, topology/state, reference and client decision.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Telemetry update rates and conversion rounding may lag AC/load changes, so timestamps, stabilization and tolerance are required.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may select a documented electrical-field subset and approve Net-SNMP instead of IReasoning, but must preserve presence/health/redundancy checkpoints and record omitted fields, original/actual tool, object-level equivalence and unverified GUI coverage.
expected_evidence: approved PSU/module index-to-slot/FRU and redundancy topology map
redacted SNMPv3 WebUI/account/ACL configuration and cleanup artifacts
vendor MIB identity with exact OID/type/index/enum/unit/scale/limit mapping
declared AC input, host load and power-policy state
complete bounded typed module/health/redundancy/electrical values correlated with independent Redfish/PMBus/WebUI telemetry
proof no power/redundancy/threshold state changed, tool/coverage statement, health logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure requires IReasoning/SNMPv3 while Criteria changes to Net-SNMP, `$target` and power-module acceptance are unresolved, and DeepSeek changes to v2c plus an unrelated generic subtree. The read-only power-module monitoring purpose remains identifiable.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Module topology, MIB objects, electrical conversion, limits and operating state are Project execution-readiness inputs for a clear read-only purpose. Once supplied and manually configured, bounded collection is automatable; permanent BLOCKED is not justified.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains hybrid execution but rejects v2c, the generic filter and unitless power evidence, adding per-module identity, redundancy and typed electrical acceptance.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Changes BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION under ED-36 while preserving hard safety gates against any power/failover control.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Independently confirms its classification and strengthens operating-state, field-coverage and independent telemetry requirements.

review_improvement: Separates presence, health, redundancy and electrical telemetry, binds every value to a physical module and operating state, and prevents read-only monitoring from expanding into power-control testing.
independent_technical_reasoning: A power reading is not meaningful without module identity, units, scale, system load and topology, and redundant health cannot be inferred from data presence. These inputs are supplyable by Project SPEC; therefore manual setup plus bounded read-only collection is REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION rather than permanent BLOCKED.
